title: Some new results on well-filteredness of $T_0$-spaces
summary: For a $T_0$-space $X$, let $Q (X)$ be the poset of nonempty compact saturated sets of $X$ with the reverse inclusion order. The space $X$ is said to have property Q if it satisfies the following two conditions: (1) $\wedge K$ exists for any $K\in Q(X)$, and (2) for any filtered family $\{K_d : d\in D\}\subseteq Q(X)$ and $x\in X$, if $\bigvee^{\uparrow}_{d\in D}\bigwedge K_d$ exists and $x\not\leq \bigvee^{\uparrow}_{d\in D}\bigwedge K_d$, then there is $\varphi\in \prod\limits_{d\in D}\!\!K_d$ and an upper bound $u$ of $\varphi(D)$ such that $x\not\leq u$.
